project: Newlands Project, Carson Division, operated by the Truckee-Carson Irrigation District (TCID)
land_class_note: ASSUMED bottom land (the lower duty, so the cautious choice). TCID's bench/bottom map for this parcel has not been checked; bench land would be 4.5 AF/acre.
duty_source: Alpine decree (United States v. Alpine Land & Reservoir Co., 503 F. Supp. 877, D. Nev. 1980), as applied in 43 CFR 418 (Newlands Project OCAP): maximum annual water duty 3.5 AF/acre for bottom lands and 4.5 AF/acre for bench lands
efficiency_source: Alpine decree: net consumptive use of 2.99 AF/acre for Newlands Project irrigation (as cited in Pyramid Lake Paiute Tribe v. Nevada, 9th Cir. 2013). Efficiency = 2.99 divided by the duty; a derived figure, not a measured one.

allocation_detail.note: Reduced to 75%; deliveries ended in September, two months early.
Set at 40% in March, raised to 50%, cut back to 45% in May.
allocation_detail.source: Associated Press, 9 May 2014, 'Drought prompts irrigation water cuts in Fallon'; Nevada Appeal, 11 Mar 2014, 'Drought limits water season'

allocation_detail.note: Set at 20% for both divisions, the lowest on record (previous low 28% in 1994).
allocation_detail.source: Northern Nevada Business Weekly, 9 Mar 2015, 'Drought is a big concern for farmers'; Nevada Appeal, 26 Mar 2015

allocation_detail.note: Set at 70% in March, later 85%, reduced to 75% on 5 July.
allocation_detail.source: Fernley Reporter, 7 Jul 2016, 'TCID announces allocation, delivery amendments'; Nevada Appeal, 3 Mar and 7 Jul 2016
The Fallon Post, 21 Feb 2019, 'TCID sets 100% water year for farmers'

allocation_detail.note: Set at 95% in March, raised to 100% by August.
allocation_detail.source: The Fallon Post, 10 Mar 2020, 'TCID sets water allocation' and 3 Aug 2020, 'High demand for water in Lahontan Reservoir'

allocation_detail.note: Set at 90% in March, cut to 70% on 5 May as the snowmelt forecast fell.
allocation_detail.source: The Fallon Post, 5 Mar 2021, 'Forecast optimistic, TCID sets allocation' and 7 May 2021, 'TCID water allocation set at 70%'; TCID board minutes, 8 Mar 2022

allocation_detail.note: Set at 70% in March, raised to 85% on 21 June after April storms; still 85% in September.
allocation_detail.source: The Fallon Post, 11 Mar 2022, 24 Jun 2022 'TCID raises the water allocation' and 9 Sep 2022

allocation_detail.note: Set at 100% for the Carson Division.
allocation_detail.source: The Fallon Post, 16 Mar 2023, 'TCID sets water allocation'

allocation_detail.note: Projected at 100% at the 12 March board meeting (a projection in the source, not a quoted board vote).
allocation_detail.source: The Fallon Post, 23 Mar 2024, 'Good news for TCID water users: 100% allocations ahead'
The Fallon Post, 14 Mar 2025, 'TCID announces 100% water supply, irrigation begins March 15'

water_cost_note: TCID fee schedule (Section H, Management Policies 2025, tcid.org): O&M charge $53.00 per acre over 7.17 acres plus District General $6.84 per acre = $59.84 per water-righted acre per year. Expressed per acre-foot over the assumed 3.5 AF bottom-land duty ($17.10/AF) because the model charges per AF delivered; TCID actually bills per acre whether or not the water is used, so fallowing does not save this charge. A Fallon Post report says O&M rises to $57 from July 2026 (not in the official schedule yet).
